question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party, state apparatus, and People's Liberation Army through extensive personnel appointments and institutional centralization, with no visible internal rivals or factional challenges emerging ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Analyses from early 2026 indicate expectations that he will pursue a fourth term in 2027 rather than relinquish power, consistent with the absence of any appointed successor and the nominal status of prior retirement norms. Trader consensus at 95.5% for "No" reflects this structural stability and low probability of removal before December 2026. Potential shifts could stem from acute health developments, a severe economic downturn prompting elite realignment, or unanticipated military or party maneuvers, though none appear imminent based on current reporting.
